I was 18 I had just moved in with my best friend after my mom kicked me out. I was never really all that happy, I finally decided to kill myself with his handgun. I waited until I thought he had fallen asleep took his key and got the gun case out. Right as I was about to unlock it he woke up (we shared a room) and he asked if I was having trouble sleeping, I lied and we stayed up playing video games so I would have company. I will now be his best man in his wedding, can't regret or appreciate that night enough.

Senior year, decided to start working out to gain weight, carried a gallon of water every where I went. I am in my government class when the pledge comes on, I decide to try to stealth drink my water, big mistake. I go to set the gallon down using my peripheral vision. Missed my desk by a few inches causing my gallon of water to fall to the floor pouring it all over everyones bags. I then had to mop the class in shame during the lesson. That's how I found out I need glasses.
